appearances.title: Bitcoin Stalls After Weak Rebound as Options Signal Caution
appearances.note: On options mean-reversion and $75k weekly-close risk.
appearances.quote: The BTC options market is showing signs of stabilizing as extreme downside fear begins to mean-revert. However, a weekly close below $75,000 would invalidate the current bounce higher, and potentially open a vacuum toward that $69,000 to $70,000 zone.

appearances.quote: Recent gains are being driven by so-called crypto-native firms… and an absence of selling by groups including Bitcoin miners, wealthy family offices and other big investment funds.

appearances.note: By Suvashree Ghosh and Muyao Shen. NY Post reprint quotes Sean on risk-off December start, meager ETF inflows, $80k support.

appearances.title: Bitcoin Sinks as Israel Escalates Iran Standoff With Airstrikes
appearances.note: By Suvashree Ghosh (and co-byline variants). Sean on liquidity over narrative in kinetic conflict. Also Gulf News / Moneyweb / Economic Times reprints.
appearances.quote: In moments of acute risk like this one, particularly involving kinetic military conflict, liquidity is prioritized over narrative. Traders raise cash, rotate into dollars, and reduce leveraged or volatile exposure.
